feed.title: Gulf Cybersecurity Baseline: Readiness
feed.subtitle: Whenever an exploited vulnerability in software visible from outside is catalogued, the first page of every live domain is read within a day, so we know how many sites still announce an affected version, and the measurement is repeated after every issue to see how fast the patches arrive.

entry.title: CVE-2026-109619 · PHP · 39.7%
entry.summary: 39.7% of the sites in the Arabian Gulf announcing a full PHP version announce one affected by the exploited vulnerability CVE-2026-109619. PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
